componentIdSynthesisNote: This componentId does not appear in the registry packetSet. The registry records the legal unit as a participant filing requirement required before filing and as a conditional apply_fee_waiver participant action. The id is synthesized by this route so the unit can carry a dependency manifest.
officialFormName: Statement of Inability to Pay Court Costs and Fees
issuingAuthority: Montana Legal Services Association (published on montanalawhelp.org); the packet carrying this form is stamped as a Montana Legal Services Association and Montana Supreme Court Access to Justice Commission product
draftingProhibitedBecause: The Montana Legal Services Association / Montana Supreme Court Access to Justice Commission packets are stamped “© 2025 Montana Legal Services Association and Montana Supreme Court Access to Justice Commission. This form may be used for non-commercial purposes only.” Expungement.ai is a paid product, so reproducing or distributing the form inside a packet is a commercial use. The form is a drafting reference only: never generated, never relabelled, never converted, never lightly rewritten, never runtime-selectable and never generation_allowed.
blockingStatement: The Office of the Court Administrator instructions route a participant who cannot pay to this form. LegalEase links to it and does not reproduce it. No fee-waiver document is produced by this route.
owningLane: lane-D/E official-source acquisition and licensing — a link-out is the only permitted treatment unless a licence to reproduce is obtained from Montana Legal Services Association.
exactMissingSource: A licence from Montana Legal Services Association / Montana Supreme Court Access to Justice Commission permitting commercial reproduction of the Statement of Inability to Pay Court Costs and Fees, or an unrestricted equivalent official form. Absent either, the form stays a link-out to montanalawhelp.org.
conditionDescription: Applies only when the participant cannot pay the sentencing court's filing fee.
profileCorroboration: statePack:fee-notes.ts mtFeeNotes[1] — “Misdemeanor packet fee waiver: a person who cannot pay may file the Statement of Inability to Pay Court Costs and Fees with its proposed order.” mtFeeNotes[2] — “Marijuana relief (§ 16-12-113): a filing fee or fee waiver applies; confirm with the court of conviction.”
feeAmountNote: No filing-fee amount is asserted. The registry states only that the participant is responsible for filing fees and costs and that the fee depends on the court level. The state pack records the same gap: “The reference does not state a fixed District Court filing-fee amount for the misdemeanor expungement or marijuana petitions; confirm the current fee with the filing court (source gap — no fee schedule provided in the Nationwide source).”
fieldsLegalEaseWouldNotFill: Every field on the form — the form is not produced at all.
Any statement of the participant's income, assets or ability to pay.
Any statement about whether a waiver will be granted.
